title: Claim the Cauldron Memory Grove: Lore Price
description: Claim the Cauldron Memory Grove: Lore Price is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate (Sealed Gate with fae time bleed). One selected deity from Dagda, Morrígan, Brigid, Lugh enters; this beat spotlights Lugh as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the treasure or lore step at Cauldron Memory Grove, using living mound-gate maze and geas trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: Avalora is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Cauldron Memory Grove and reveals: A mound-carving suggesting sealed Gates may be mercy, not prison. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Cauldron Memory Grove configured as a treasure or lore space inside living mound-gate maze and geas trial; source-culture appearance layer: sídhe mound gates, moon-grove rootlabyrinths, silver-root lanes, standing stone courts, cauldron-lit springs, thorn covenant walls; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Lugh silver-spear thornblades, moon-oak sídhe mantles, Dagda cauldron memory cores, fae glamour reversals
